items.quote: By now you’ll have decided if you like the show, and I love it, greedily gobbling down every episode as if it were a sonnet on a plate. Pop on your napkin (cloth, paper, doesn’t matter) and enjoy.
items.author: Barbara Ellen

items.quote: By the end, many of the questions of season two remain, particularly the types that one might expect a TV dramedy to rush to answer: the resolution of ongoing conflicts and the will-they-won’t-they of a romance. In the end, though, it hardly matters, as Storer has managed to keep the center of interest away from such plot-driven considerations.
items.author: Pat Brown
